text:
Clara: Heads-up Found a duplicate invoice situation for ChimeWave (CW-900). Two invoices for April window; one missing the CDN egress line (~$620).
Omar: IDs?
Clara: CW-2024-04-3007 (full, $6,420.00) and CW-2024-04-3007-RETRY (partial, $5,800.00). The RETRY was generated but not paid.
Priya: Any customer emails sent?
BillingBot: [alert] invoice-generator: created draft CW-2024-04-3007-RETRY (job: ig-8821)
Omar: Quick log snippet:
```
2024-04-30T08:10:11Z WARN usage-cache: missing cdn_egress for account CW-900 window=2024-04
2024-04-30T08:10:12Z INFO invoice-generator: create draft CW-2024-04-3007-RETRY
```
Priya: Looks like retry path used stale cache. Remediation: mark RETRY draft "do-not-send" and void, add a short backoff before retry, and run a scan for other "-RETRY" drafts in April.
Clara: Placed hold on sends and filed ticket FIN-6344. Attached logs.
Omar: I'll open a quick patch to rehydrate usage cache on retry. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/invoice-generator/pulls/1967
Priya: Also message support so they can reassure ChimeWave if they see two PDFs. Draft: "We found an internal duplicate draft; only CW-2024-04-3007 was charged. We'll void the draft and re-send the correct invoice."
Clara: Done. Will close FIN-6344 after void + cleanup. :thumbsup:
